name: Event Sourcing + CQRS Pattern
description: Mutations are captured as immutable, append-only domain events. Current state is derived by folding the event log through a pure projector function (CQRS read side). Commands (write side) validate intent and emit events; they never mutate state directly.

nodes.name: Command (intent)
nodes.description: A request to change state. Validated by a command handler against current projection. Rejected or translated into one or more events. Never mutates state directly.

nodes.name: Command Handler (write side)
nodes.description: Validates a command against current state, emits domain events. Part of Application layer. One handler per command type.

nodes.name: Domain Event (fact)
nodes.description: An immutable record of something that happened. Has a stable unique ID (UUIDv7 URN), a monotonic sequence number, an occurredAt timestamp, and a typed payload. Events are never edited or deleted.

nodes.name: Event Store
nodes.description: Append-only log of domain events, keyed by aggregate ID. The single source of truth at runtime. Implemented as a Port; concrete adapters: LocalStorageEventStore, InMemoryEventStore (tests), HttpSyncEventStore (future).

nodes.name: Projector (read side)
nodes.description: Pure function: reduce(events, initialState) → Document. Deterministic: same events always produce the same document. Part of Application layer. Cacheable (snapshot) without loss of correctness.

nodes.name: Snapshot Cache (optional)
nodes.description: Cached projection to avoid full-log replay on boot. Always invalidatable: the event log is authoritative. Implemented as SnapshotStore port.

nodes.name: Query (read side)
nodes.description: Reads from the current projection (the document). Never touches the event store directly. Examples: LoadCurrentDocument, ExportDocument.

relationships.description: Commands are dispatched to their handler
Handler validates and emits one or more domain events
Events are appended to the event store (append-only, never overwrite)
Projector folds the full event log into the current document
Projector may bootstrap from a snapshot to avoid full replay
Queries read from the projection; they never touch the event store directly
